question: List the elements of all the triple bonds.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN BondDetails AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
